zh:
汤念念八岁那年，大水淹了家。
她记得，夜里被轰隆隆的水声惊醒，她爹把她举上房顶，自己没来得及爬上去。
她趴在瓦片上，看着院子里漂起锅盖和板凳，还有她爹的草帽。
她在房顶上趴了一天一夜，又冷又饿，嗓子哭哑了，连喊救命都没了力气。
水退下去的时候，她踩着泥浆往外走，走了多久自己也记不清。
脚上的鞋丢了一只，脚磨破了，一步一个血印子。
她饿了好些天，最后眼前一黑，就倒在了乐安浦外边的野菜地里。
是范芗芗发现了她，把她抱了起来。
范芗芗熬了一锅鱼汤，白花花的汤底，鱼肉撕成碎末，里头还卧了个荷包蛋。
汤念念喝了一口，烫得嘴起泡，可她死活不肯松口，抱着碗喝了个底朝天。
范芗芗看着她狼吞虎咽的样子，眼圈越发红了，暗自打定主意，往后让这丫头跟着自己过活。
从那以后，汤念念就留在了乐安浦。
如今她长大了，个头蹿得比范芗芗还高，说话脆生生的，嗓门大，脾气也急。
在摊子前面切菜端菜，手脚麻利得很，嘴上却从不闲着。
“娘！你又给人白吃白喝！咱家净做亏本的生意！”
范芗芗也不恼，笑呵呵地往锅里再添一勺油。
汤念念叹了口气，手里的菜刀剁得砧板咣咣响。
en:
When Tang Niannian was eight years old, the floodwaters swallowed her home.
She still remembered waking in the dead of night to the deafening roar of the water. Her father had hoisted her up onto the roof, but he hadn't been fast enough to pull himself up after her.
Clinging to the slippery tiles, she watched helplessly as pot lids, wooden stools, and her father's straw hat drifted away across the flooded courtyard.
She was trapped up there for a day and a night. Freezing, starving, and crying until her voice gave out, she eventually didn't even have the strength to whisper for help.
When the water finally went down, she waded out through the thick mud. She never knew how long she walked. She'd lost a shoe somewhere along the way, and her bare foot was rubbed raw, leaving a bloody print with every step.
As she was overcome with exhaustion and hunger, her vision finally went black, and she collapsed in a patch of wild greens just outside the Tranquil Pier.
That was where Fan Xiangxiang found her.
Xiangxiang scooped the girl up, took her home, and brewed a pot of rich, milky-white fish soup. The fish was carefully flaked apart, with a plump poached egg nestled right in the center. Niannian took one greedy gulp and blistered her mouth, but she refused to let go, clutching the bowl like a lifeline until she'd licked it completely clean. Watching the little girl inhale the food, Xiangxiang felt her eyes burn with tears. Right then and there, she made a quiet promise to herself: This girl is staying with me.
And so, Tang Niannian never left Tranquil Pier.
Years later, she has shot up to be even taller than her adoptive mother. She's loud, sharp-tongued, and has a temper that flares up at the drop of a hat. She works the front of their bustling food stall, chopping vegetables and slinging dishes with lightning speed, though her mouth works just as fast as her hands.
"Mum! You're letting people eat for free again! We're running a charity here, not a business!"
Fan Xiangxiang never gets mad. She just chuckles warmly and scoops a little extra oil into the wok.
Niannian heaves a heavy sigh, turning back to her prep station and bringing her cleaver down on the cutting board with a dramatic THWACK, THWACK, THWACK.

zh:
再怎么样，也浇不灭、吹不熄两个少年要寻鲸的心。
雨夜下的大海，孤舟恰浮萍。直至雨停浪息。
二人已在大海里飘荡了十数个时辰，湿了行囊、鞋袜，见了雷雨里翻出海面的鱼狸，见了横亘天边的长虹，见了逐浪追波的鱼群。
可这些，都不是鲸。
忽地，从北面飘来一堆堆黢黑的物什。萧鹤衣觉着，该是见到鲸了。可近了一看，是些破烂的木甲，倒下的旗帜，顺着滹沱的入海口，竟漂到了这里。
中原逐鹿之地，又起刀兵。
这一次，那面旗帜上所书的，乃是一个晋字。
“萧兄，我知道鲸在哪里了。”
“在哪？”
“在中原，在燕云，在北关。”
林险生引经据典，信手拈来。“《左传》云，古者明王伐不敬，取其鲸鲵而封之，以为大戮。”林险生顿了顿，“北面，北面有鲸。”
“你是说……”萧鹤衣蓦然觉着，有一个庞然巨物出现在他们的头顶。那是他们二人自游学来，从未亲自接触过的物事。一个如鲸般，幽黑、庞大、恐怖的物事。
萧鹤衣想，他大概想象出鲸是什么样子了。
那头可以吞下天地的鲸，而今正从北面，往南吞，想要很快就吞掉这里。
可那头想要吞掉中原的巨鲸，还未问过少年的剑，答不答应。
林险生说，走，我们去找鲸。
萧鹤衣点点头，摇橹向北去。
孤舟下，一个百丈的黑影，在船底逡巡，倏忽又不见踪影。
两个少年在天光破开的乌云下一齐高歌。
站船头的少年，笑问，“你可知道我最喜欢哪首写鲸的诗？”
船尾的少年朗笑，“知道，你喜欢李太白，喜欢他的那首——”
天光洒在少年的脸上，只听二人朗声唱道：
“风号沙宿潇湘浦，节士悲秋泪如雨。白日当天心，照之可以事明主。
壮士愤，雄风生。
安得倚天剑， 跨海斩长鲸！”
en:
Nothing could quench the two boys' desire to find the whale.
On that storm-dark sea, their lone skiff drifted like duckweed, until the rain stopped and the waves fell still.
By then they had been adrift for more than ten hours. Their packs were soaked through, their shoes and socks drenched. They had seen storm-tossed sea beasts leaping from the water, seen a long rainbow laid across the horizon, seen schools of fish chasing the swell.
But none of it was the whale.
Then, suddenly, black shapes began drifting down from the north. For a moment Xiao Heyi thought they had found it at last. But when the wreckage drew near, he saw broken lamellar, splintered timber, fallen banners—debris swept all the way out from the mouth of the Hutuo River and carried here by the tide.
Once again, war had broken out in the lands of the Central Plains.
And on one torn banner, a single character still showed clear: Jin.
"Brother Xiao," Lin Xiansheng said, "I know where the whale is now."
"Where?"
"In the Central Plains. In Yanyun. At the northern passes."
Lin Xiansheng spoke as he always did, reaching into the old texts as easily as drawing breath. "The Commentary of Zuo says: In ancient times, when wise kings marched against the defiant, they seized the great threats among them and put them to death as a warning to all." He paused, then said, "There is a whale in the north."
"You mean..." Suddenly, Xiao Heyi felt as though some vast thing had risen above them. It was something neither of them had ever truly seen before—immense, dark, and terrible. A whale, yes, but not one of flesh and blood.
Xiao Heyi thought he finally understood what a whale was.
A thing vast enough to swallow heaven and earth was coming down from the north, swallowing southward, meaning to devour this place as well.
But the great whale that meant to swallow the Central Plains had yet to ask a young man's sword whether it would permit it.
Lin Xiansheng said, "Come. Let's go find the whale."
Xiao Heyi nodded and turned the oar north.
Beneath the skiff, a dark shadow a hundred zhang long passed once under the hull, then vanished without a trace.
Under clouds split open by the breaking light, the two boys lifted their voices and sang together.
The boy at the bow laughed and asked, "Do you know which poem about whales I like best?"
The boy at the stern laughed back. "Of course. Li Taibai. The one you're always quoting—"
Sunlight fell across their faces as the two of them sang aloud:
"The wind howls over the sands by the Xiao and Xiang Rivers; a loyal man grieves in autumn, his tears falling like rain. The bright sun stands at heaven's heart, by its light one may serve a worthy lord.
When a true man burns with anger, a mighty wind begins to rise.
If only I had a sword to lean against the sky, I would cross the sea and cut down the mighty whale!"
Disciple Li

斜斜歪歪的字，一行一行记着一笔特殊的账。

入：
“#Y天显十一年#E，引□□去渡口，□□十文。”
“#Y天福二年#E，为行商引去□□驿，得干粮一包，饼三枚。”
“#Y天福三年#E，借火照路，得谢钱五文。”
……
“#Y开运三年#E，河中捞得衫二、鞋一。换钱三文。”

出：
“#Y天显十一年#E，借王大哥鱼一□，记欠。已还。”
“#Y天福二年#E，雨大，得李婶送□衣一件，记欠。已还。”
“#Y天福三年#E，病中，庆嫂代汲水三桶，记欠。已还。”
……
“#Y开运三年#E，李阿公送稻米半斗，记欠。未还。”

还有些无关的记录：
“李阿公教芦花识‘芦’‘花’二字。”
“又识薇、归二字。”
……

纸上墨迹深浅不一，显然记了许多年。如今这账再也平不了了。
en:
Slanted, crooked characters, line by line, recording a special ledger.

Income:
#YYear 11 of Tianxian#E guided □□ to the ferry, received □□ ten coins.
#YYear 2 of Tianfu#E, guided a traveling merchant to □□ station, received one pack of dry rations, three flatbreads.
#YYear 3 of Tianfu#E, borrowed fire for light, received thanks money five coins.
...
#YYear 3 of Kaiyun#E, fished two shirts and one pair of shoes from the river. Sold for three coins.

Expenditure:
#YYear 11 of Tianxian#E, borrowed one □ fish from Brother Wang, recorded as debt. Already repaid.
#YYear 2 of Tianfu#E, heavy rain, received one □ coat from Aunt Li, recorded as debt. Already repaid.
#YYear 3 of Tianfur#E, ill, Sister Qing drew three buckets of water for me, recorded as debt. Already repaid.
...
#YYear 3 of Kaiyun#E, Uncle Li gave half a dou of rice, recorded as debt. Not yet repaid.

Some unrelated records:
Uncle Li taught Luhua the characters 'Lu' and 'Hua'.
Also taught the characters 'Wei' and 'Gui'.
...

The ink shades on the paper vary, clearly recorded over many years. Now this ledger can never be balanced.

zh: 在活动中消耗长鸣珠可购买「莲莲荷包」，打开1个「莲莲荷包」后会获得1个「福龟」或其他奖励。当获得「福龟」时，如触发「对碰」「三连」或「全清」，则可获得兑换积分「莲池乐」，并返还一定数量的「莲莲荷包」。返还的「莲莲荷包」即刻开启并不进入背包，「莲池乐」可在活动商店中兑换限定外观和丰富奖励。每个角色最多购买1400次「莲莲荷包」（不包括返还规则获得的福袋）。九宫格棋盘初始会赠送8个完全不同的「福龟」。当「莲莲荷包」获得道具奖励时，不再获得「福龟」。活动结束后，购买的「莲莲荷包」将以16个兑换1个袅袅之音进行系统回收，不足16个的「莲莲荷包」将以1:10兑换为长鸣玉。活动结束后至兑换下架期间内，可参与兑换不可参与祈福，最终未消耗的「莲池乐」积分将以16:1自动回收为长鸣玉。参与2次祈福可获得赠礼配饰·福龟陶模，消耗「泥釉彩」可在「陶陶试衣」中解锁更多「福龟陶模」样式。
en:
During the event, spend Echo Beads to buy [Lotus Pouches]. Open a [Lotus Pouch] to receive either 1 [Lucky Turtle] or another reward.
If you get a [Lucky Turtle] and trigger a Match, Three-in-a-Row, or All Clear, you will receive [Lotus Cheer] and some [Lotus Pouches] back. Refunded [Lotus Pouches] are opened immediately and will not be added to your inventory.
[Lotus Cheer] can be exchanged in the event shop for limited cosmetics and other rewards. Each character can buy up to 1,400 [Lotus Pouches], not including those obtained through refunds. The 3x3 board starts with 8 different [Lucky Turtles].
If a [Lotus Pouch] gives an item reward, you will not receive a [Lucky Turtle].
After the event ends, purchased [Lotus Pouches] will be automatically reclaimed at a rate of 16 for 1 [Lingering Melody]. Any remaining [Lotus Pouches] fewer than 16 will be converted into Echo Jade at a rate of 1:10.
After the event ends, you can still exchange rewards until the shop closes, but you can no longer Pray. Any unused [Lotus Cheer] will be automatically converted into Echo Jade at a rate of 16:1.
Pray 2 times to receive the gift accessory [Lucky Turtle Charm]. Spend [Glaze Palette] in [Pottery Styling] to unlock more [Lucky Turtle Charm] styles.

《烧焙笔记》
初以炭火焙生球，未及三刻，声响如雷，球裂而不得。思其因外燥内湿，气不得出。
后改阴干一日，再以苇席覆之，慢火熏蒸，渐去水汽。
终入锻窑，叠薪煅烧，窑温灼面，持火色橘黄凡两时辰。
出窑视之，球坚如石，相击有金声！
en:
Firing Notes
Initially, I fired the raw balls with charcoal fire. Before 45 minutes passed, there was a sound like thunder, and the balls cracked, failing. I thought the reason was that the outside was dry and the inside wet, the steam having no way out.
Later, I changed to air-drying for one day, then covering with reed mats and smoking with slow fire to gradually remove moisture.
Finally, I put them in the forging kiln, stacking fuel and firing. The kiln temperature was scorching hot. I maintained an orange flame color for four hours.
When I took them out of the kiln, the balls were as hard as stone and rang with a metallic sound when struck!

After the Song dynasty, common folk shortened the purple mandarin duck's name to mandarin duck, and later generations came to conflate the two. 你与她有同入孤云之谊，如今又恰好在藏书馆游学，妙的是姓林的也不在门中，这不正是天赐之良机？你二人年岁相当，品性相投，一个沉稳可靠，一个聪慧机敏，若说没有几分天作之合的缘分，为师是断然不信的。昔日文津馆挖我墙脚，今日你便连人带心都给她挖回来！新词迷途未远，你只管使出手段，令其重返我孤云正道。
为师知晓弟子中属你最靠谱不过，定能办妥这桩大事。切记，行事万不可莽撞，若教文津馆发觉，只怕你要被唾沫星子淹死，为师也得跟着大大丢人。
归时不拘早晚，但人得给为师带回来。若是人带不回来，你便在藏书馆抄完他们的四书五经再返归吧，在那之前，你带在身上的算筹、星图、勾股板先给为师寄回来！
师 谢韫
en:
To My Dear Disciple:
It's been nearly a month since I sent you, boy, to study in Qingzhou. Have you figured out which way the Archives' doors even open yet? And that important task I entrusted to you before you left… do you still remember it?
I've long heard that Tang Xinci has taken up post at the Qingzhou Archives. Of all the Lone Cloud disciples these past years, that girl is by far the cleverest and most gifted, and above all, she respects her teacher properly, unlike this bunch of rebellious brats in our sect. What a pity she was lured away by that smooth-tongued, pale-faced pedant Lin Xiansheng… Truly a case of "a pearl cast into darkness!" Every time I think of it, I must drown my anger in a full cup of wine.
You share the bond of having entered Lone Cloud together with her, and now, as luck would have it, you're studying at the Archives too, while that Lin fellow happens to be away from the sect. Could there be a more heaven-sent opportunity? You two are of similar age, alike in character, one steady and reliable, the other clever and quick-witted. If this isn't a match made by fate, I refuse to believe it. Back then, the Inkbound Order poached my talent; now it's your turn to steal both her and her heart right back! Xinci hasn't strayed too far from the right path. Use whatever means necessary to bring her back to Lone Cloud's true way.
I know full well that among my disciples, you're the most dependable, and you'll surely handle this important task properly. But remember: do not act recklessly. If the Inkbound Order catches wind of this, you'll be drowned in spit and ridicule, and I'll be humiliated right along with you.
No matter how much time you spend, you must bring her back with you. If you fail to bring her back, you'd best finish copying out their Four Books and Five Classics before you return. And before that, send back the counting rods, star charts, and triangle square you took!
Your Master, Xie Yun

落下啦。

太阳升起又落下，月亮停在树枝桠。
红色的宴会黑色的河，宾客醉倒在我家。
故乡山丘摇晃晃，睡吧睡吧前事忘。
故乡山丘月汪汪，睡吧睡吧黑夜长。
en:
Sun comes up and sun goes down,
The moon hangs on a branch's crown.
The barefoot child from far-off lands,
Brings green, green grapes into my hands.
We build a frame for vines to grow,
Then bury them in earth below.
The dark clouds eat the stars so bright,
The coldest wind is wine tonight.

Oh, moonlight, moonlight, tell me true,
Is life always a sweet, soft dew?
The little one, no word they say,
Asleep beneath the lunar ray.
Oh, moonlight, moonlight, tell me please,
Is fate always a gentle breeze?
The weeping one just waves their hand,
Their ruby eyes light up the land.

The moon...
It falls.

Sun comes up and sun goes down,
The moon hangs on a branch's crown.
Red is the feast, black is the stream,
Drunk are the guests within a dream.
The hills of home rock to and fro,
Sleep now, sleep, and let it go.
The hills of home in moonbeams steep,
Sleep now, sleep, the night is deep.

zh:
年轻人：
       好久不见，最近过得还好吗？
       托你的福，摊子的生意很好。你阿婶她很久没有这么高兴了，每天笑盈盈地和来往客人唠家常，开心的时候还会借着琵琶摊小娘子的曲子跳上几步！不忙的时候，老张和老幺还张罗着去和赛神队的几个小伙子比赛，哈哈。
      天水集的大伙儿都会提起你，说你行侠仗义，我们听着都很开心，也惦记着你。你阿婶怕你在外面吃不饱穿不暖，时常念叨你呢。有时间就来摊子坐坐啊。
      对了，开烫菜摊子赚了些钱，我们想着也帮衬帮衬别人，就做了些饭菜送给了几个老伙计。怕他们觉得不好意思，我们几个就说，是你要给他们送的。他们还奇怪，说怎么会有没见过的好心人惦记他们呢。老张说这孩子就是这样的，是个热心肠的大侠！他们不太好意思，就给你写了字条，你一起看看吧。
      好了，不说了，待会要来客人了，就到这儿吧。
      希望你一个人在外吃饱穿暖，平平安安。
<IMAGE id='im1' image_url='https://h72.fp.ps.netease.com/file/6891d87bb9e2e45f44986b73YyijyJHm06' size='2290*1296' color='255;255;255')'></IMAGE>
en:
Young Hero: 
Long time no see. How have you been? 
Thanks to you, the stall is doing great. Your Auntie hasn't been this happy in ages—she smiles, chatting with customers all day, and even dances a few steps when the Pipa lady plays! When it's slow, Old Zhang and Old Yao even try to race the lads from the deity competition team, haha. 
Everyone at Skybrim Market speaks of your chivalry. We are happy to hear it and miss you often. Your Auntie worries you aren't eating well or staying warm. She talks about you all the time. Come visit the stall when you can. 
Oh, we made some money from the scalding vegetable stall, so we thought we'd help others out. We sent some food to a few old partners. We were afraid they'd feel embarrassed, so we said it was from you. They were surprised a kind hero remembered them! Old Zhang said, "That child is just warm-hearted like that!" They were shy, so they wrote you notes. Take a look. 
Okay, customers are coming. I'll stop here. 
Stay warm, fed, and safe out there.

zh:
听雷轩为宫中斗虫结社，潜心专研斗蛐蛐技艺，将心得汇编成册，以飨同好。本月由后苑翠衫客执笔，望诸位斧正。
“捕、养、斗”乃斗虫必修功课。究竟怎么样才能选出与自己相契的罐中大将呢？笔者也很好奇，笔者也想知道。
其一·相虫之章
特邀兵部范大人讲述相虫心得。
“识虫如识将，眼拙者，未战先败！
老夫混迹官场十余年，经历两朝而屹立底层不倒，皆凭识人有方。
识虫亦同理。头色为主，翅色为副，项色为配，肉色为助。有“一眼霸王”，头形峥嵘，星门冲凸，性情刚烈，宁折不弯。此类虫将往往牙尖带钩，专破彼方头甲，无往不胜。
亦有四平八稳，不显山露水的铁锈苍狸，厘码虽小，斗力之长却实为罕见。争先克敌是为勇，委屈诱敌是为智，人有百态，虫亦如是。”
编者注：
学无止境。向范大人学习识人识虫之术，我将在斗虫界底层屹立不倒！

其二·饲育之章
本章由甲甲甲·斗虫饵食皇宫特供·小张子赞助。
”这玩虫子，跟咱们当差一样，路子得正，身子骨得硬。有些外行为了求胜，给虫喂辣椒，万万不可取！
总结一下，在斗场上把对方掀翻，要讲究“鲜”和“慢”。
鲜，指的是每日饵食均应更换，确保新鲜。
慢，指的就是一点点把虫子养起来，急不得。
在此隆重推荐本人的扁担虫饵料，实打实的补，欲购从速！“
编者注：
本章节持续招募赞助。

其三·宗师问对
受访者：“瞻云客”
编者：
詹师傅，您作为大内斗蛐蛐第一高手，怎么看待多流派混战一事？
瞻云客：
“各有各的打法嘛！咬、摔、举、掐,勾、拖、滚、捺，都是虫儿的战术。
这就和高手过招一个道理，体、智、技三者合一而胜。
蛐蛐只有一个罐子的天地，人的路子，可不能比蛐蛐还窄。
你若看不出虫子的路数，趁早把虫子放生，免得它替你送死。
输赢是小事，让虫王见面较量，学学虫德，才是大事。好咯，我要去做木匠活咯！”

封底
编者注：真是一次酣畅淋漓的采访啊！
en:
Thunderclap Society is the palace's cricket-fighting club. We have put our notes and hard-won tricks into this booklet for fellow enthusiasts. This month's issue is penned by the Verdant Strider of the Rear Garden. Comments are welcome.

In cricket-fighting, "catch, raise, fight" are the three essentials. But how do you pick the right champion for your jar? We are curious too. We want to know.

Part I: Judging a Cricket

We invited Lord Fan of the Ministry of War to share his tips on sizing up a fighter.

"To judge a cricket is to judge a general. If your eye is bad, you lose before the match even starts.

"I have been in office for over a decade, served through two reigns, and still managed to keep my footing. That is all from knowing how to read people. Crickets work the same way.

"Start with head color, then wing color. Check the neck, and use the body tone as a final clue. Some are called 'one-glance overlords': rugged heads, bulging brow marks, a hard temper that will not bend. Fighters like that often have sharp, hooked jaws, made to pierce an opponent's head casing. They win more often than not.

"Others look steady and plain, the rust-grey type that never shows off. Small, maybe, but their staying power is rare. Charging first and breaking through is courage. Taking a hit to lure the enemy in is brains. People come in all kinds, and so do crickets."

Editor's Note:
There is no end to learning. If I can learn Lord Fan's way of reading both people and crickets, then I can stay at the bottom of the cricket world without getting knocked out.

Part II: Feeding and Rearing

This section is sponsored by Little Zhangzi's AAA Palace-Supply Cricket Feed.

"Raising a cricket is like being on duty. Your methods have to be right, and the little fellow has to be tough. Some amateurs, hungry for a win, feed their crickets chili. Do not do that.

"If you want your fighter to flip the other one in the ring, remember two words: fresh and slow.

"Fresh means changing the feed every day.
"Slow means building it up bit by bit. No rushing.

"And since we are here, I recommend my own Carrying-Pole Cricket Feed. Honest nourishment, solid stuff. Limited stock, get it while you can."

Editor's Note:
Sponsorships are still welcome for this section.

Part III: Master Q&A

Interviewee: "Cloud Gazer"
Editor: Master Zhan, as the top cricket fighter in the inner palace, what do you make of all these schools mixing it up?

Cloud Gazer: "Different schools, different moves. Bite. Throw. Lift. Pinch. Hook. Drag. Roll. Press. Those are all tactics a cricket can use.

"It is the same as two masters trading blows. You win when strength, brains, and technique come together.

"A cricket's world is one little jar. Do not make your own world even smaller than that.

"If you cannot even tell what kind of fighter your cricket is, let it go now. Do not send it into the ring just to die for you.

"Winning and losing are small things. The point is to let the kings meet, trade moves, and learn some sportsmanship. Alright. I have carpentry to get back to."

Back Cover
Editor's Note: What a satisfying interview that was.
Determined

zh: 天天是墨城里一个小男孩所养的小猫，它的主人跟别的墨城里的小男孩一样。当别人问及，以后想做什么的时候，它的主人便自信满满地说，以后想当一个大匠师，实现那飞天的梦想。天天的名字，就是那个时候取的。 天天和它的主人，每天都躺在廊桥旁，看着天上。 只是后来，不知道什么时候起，它的主人不再跟它躺一块儿了。 它的主人有了事要做，总是在墨城的铺子里奔忙， 那个年少的梦想，也像白云一样飘远了。 只有天天，还和从前一样，天天望着天上。

Tiantian belonged to a little boy in Mohist City, a boy with a dream.
When asked what he'd be, he'd puff up his chest and announce he'd be a Grand Master, a builder of flying machines. That's how Sky got his name.
Every day, they'd lie together by the covered bridge, just staring up at the clouds.
But then, slowly, the boy stopped coming. He had things to do now, errands in the workshops.
That childhood dream seemed to float away, like the clouds they used to watch. Only Tiantian stays, still lying by the bridge and gazing at the heavens, day after day.

To the Raging Tides Commander,

I have failed you. During the breakout in the north, I was grievously wounded and separated from my fellow disciples. Yet while recovering at this manor, I learned that the Qi family had once been deceived by Du Chongwei, and that a great hoard of wealth wrung from the people had been hidden within the tunnels. The northern foe has only just gained a foothold here. They do not yet know where the treasure lies, nor have they received much in the way of reinforcement. I have therefore resolved to take this risk.
If fortune favors me and I recover the people's wealth, so much the better. If I should die instead, then that last mouthful of River All Red bestowed by you, Commander, I shall leave in some fitting place deep within Sheathed Passage. When you find it, you may drink with your disciple once more.

The northern foe has already broken into the rear of the camp, seized Ragehoof Hamlet, and entrenched themselves within the underground Sheathed Passage, clearly intending to cut off the grain route.
...
The Qi family's horse trainers at the manor have all been coerced. The enemy holds four hostages in total, and their lives hang in the balance.

zh:
吾与弟无名姓，襁褓弃于魏州兴化寺。方丈收为弟子，取名阿执、阿破，曰：此名出佛经，破执断妄也。

开运二年秋，契丹破魏州。寺僧皆死，佛身金箔尽剥。
吾兄弟藏地窖得活，于废墟得二物：方丈旧砚、剃发匕首。

是年冬，携弟南遁，几丧胡骑蹄下。
幸有侠客祁小舟救之，恍若寺中观音再世。

……小舟托吾等入胜乐门，本意慈悲，岂知堕地狱。
韦氏父子以活人为鼎炉，修习邪功，惨绝人寰。吾暗誓：纵吾死，必令阿破生！

……助弟遁走，授以匕首。嘱曰：若得活，莫忘来路。
后闻尸陀林守言：阿破坠崖，尸骨糜烂。
……韦氏恶鬼，纵堕无间，必索汝命！

……韦一渡庸才，竟慕小舟。命吾代笔修书，伪作其迹。初拟告难，然信笺皆受检视，遂作罢。
惟效魏碑临书——小舟甚喜此体。
砚墨重研，如见故寺青灯。伊每笺至，若破狱天光。

……苦等六载，终杀韦氏父子，虽行恶孽，其心不悔。

……小舟竟允婚！狂喜之余，恐事泄。得韦氏遗物“洛神帖”，遂易韦一渡皮囊。
洛神其人，色厉心慈……九真一诳，竟成鸳盟。

……胜乐门余徒十余人，皆天资鲁钝者。幸其愚钝，免为鼎炉。某携之隐入深谷，欲使此门湮没江湖。

……小舟忽横剑自刎于庭前，血溅素衣。……十载已逝，何由知旧孽？……必是胜乐余徒泄密，吾尽屠之！
小舟既死，岂愿独活？……惟求洛神复吾本面，泉下再见小舟，定当如实相告——吾乃阿执，非韦氏鬼！
en:
My brother and I had no names. We were abandoned in our swaddling clothes at the Xinghua Temple in Weizhou. The abbot took us in as disciples and named us Zhi and Po. He said the names came from Buddhist scriptures: to break attachments and sever delusions.
In the autumn of the second year of Kaiyun, the Khitan breached Weizhou. All the monks in the temple perished, and the gold leaf was entirely stripped from the Buddha statues. My brother and I survived by hiding in a cellar. In the ruins, we found two items: the abbot's old inkstone and the dagger used for shaving heads.
That winter, I fled south with my brother, nearly dying beneath the hooves of barbarian steeds. Fortunately, the swordswoman Qi Xiaozhou saved us, appearing like the reincarnated Bodhisattva of our temple.
...Xiaozhou entrusted us to the Shengle Sect. Her original intent was sheer mercy; little did she know she was casting us into hell. The Wei father and son used living humans as cultivation cauldrons to practice their wicked arts. It was a tragedy beyond human endurance. I swore an oath in the dark: even if I must die, I will ensure Po lives!
...I helped my brother escape and handed him the dagger. I told him: if you survive, never forget where you came from. Later, I heard from the Shmashana Grove Guardian that Po had fallen off a cliff, his bones crushed to dust. ...You wicked demons of the Wei clan, even if I fall into the Avici Hell, I will claim your lives!
...That mediocrity, Wei Yidu, dared to lust after Xiaozhou. He ordered me to ghostwrite his letters, forging his hand. At first, I intended to draft a plea for help, but every letter was inspected, so I had to abandon the thought. I solely copied the style of the Wei Stele rubbings; Xiaozhou was exceedingly fond of this calligraphy. Grinding the ink once more, it was as if I saw the solitary lamp of my ruined temple. Every time her letter arrived, it was like a ray of heavenly light piercing through hell.
...After six bitter years of waiting, I finally slaughtered the Wei father and son. Though I committed a wicked deed, my heart holds no regret.
...Xiaozhou actually agreed to the marriage proposal! Amidst my wild joy, I feared exposure. I obtained the Wei clan's relic, the Water Lady Script, and used it to change into Wei Yidu's visage. This Water Lady was severe in appearance yet merciful in heart... Nine truths and one lie somehow sealed our marriage vow.
...Over ten surviving disciples remained in the Shengle Sect, all of whom possessed dull aptitudes. Fortunately, their very dullness spared them from becoming cauldrons. I took them with me and retreated into a deep valley, wishing to let this sect fade into oblivion within the martial world.
...Suddenly, Xiaozhou drew her sword and slit her own throat in the courtyard, blood splattering across her plain white robes. ...Ten years have passed; how could she have learned of the old sins? ...It must be those remnants of the Shengle Sect who leaked the secret. I will slaughter them all! Since Xiaozhou is dead, why should I wish to live on? ...I only beg Luoshen to restore my true face. When I meet Xiaozhou again in the underworld, I shall tell her the absolute truth: I am Azhi, not a ghost of the Wei clan!
Mei Yu

鹳之提问守则其一：当你与鹳长老坚定对视时，那么你将被提问。

鹳之提问守则其四：不要妄图躲避提问，否则你将目光闪躲，那么参见其二，你将被提问。
…… 
没有被鹳长老“考一考”过的墨门求学生涯，不是真正的求学生涯！ 
无论课业优劣，只要在墨城之内，你都可能被不知哪里冒出来的鹳长老“逮住”开考！而只要被鹳长老“逮住”，便要被考上少说半个时辰了。直考得你面红耳赤，羞愤难当，外焦里嫩，方是够了火候。老头子这才会闭目思索，似是回味。确认你身上飘出了些学识烘烤的香味，方可拍拍你的肩膀，放你离去。 
“我来考考你”仿若一句墨城神咒，烙印在每一个墨城弟子的耳中，无一幸免。
 鹳长老施这“神咒”，自然亦有他的道理： 
你若不会，那恰该让我考考你，于考中学，记忆深刻，说不得就会了？
你若会了，那何惧我来考考你？同门师生对谈，互相印证所思所想，更有裨益。 
你若说你似会似不会，更不必说，最需我来考考你，助你查漏补缺，解惑释疑。
而墨城弟子们虽常被问得头顶冒烟，脚底发汗，却真如于热泉中蒸了一道，颇有些神明气清之感。回住处细细思量，更常有所得。 
于是对于鹳长老的“考一考”，大家便颇有了些又爱又恨的味道。
被考便被考吧，就当是发一发汗、历了砭石，虽当时免不得头昏脑涨、刮肚烧心，事后终归是得利的。 
反过来想想，若是有一日，连鹳长老都不愿再“考考你”，那才是让人害怕的事嘞！ 
好在，直至今日，墨城之中，还未曾有一人，鹳长老不愿去考。
en:
The Stork's Code of Questioning.
Rule 1: If you lock eyes with Elder Stork, you will be questioned.
Rule 2: If you avoid Elder Stork's gaze, you will be questioned.
Rule 3: The moment you think you might be questioned, you will be questioned.
Rule 4: Do not attempt to dodge the question. Doing so counts as avoiding his gaze, which, as stated in Rule 2, means you will be questioned.

...

An apprenticeship in Mohist City without surviving Elder Stork's pop quizzes is no apprenticeship at all.

No matter your grades, as long as you are within the city walls, Elder Stork might pop out of thin air to ambush you with a test. And once caught, you can expect a relentless interrogation lasting no less than an hour. He will grill you until your face burns red with shame and you are thoroughly roasted inside and out. Only when he closes his eyes, savoring the faint aroma of knowledge being forged within your spirit, will he finally pat your shoulder and let you go.

"Let me quiz you." This phrase is the divine curse of Mohist City, branded into the ears of every single disciple without exception.

Elder Stork naturally has his reasons for casting this curse.
"If you don't know the answer, then you need to be tested. Learning through the fire of inquiry etches the lesson into your mind. Who knows, you might just figure it out!"
"If you already know the answer, why fear the test? A dialogue between master and disciple sharpens the minds of both. It is highly beneficial."
"If you sort of know it but sort of don't, then you need my quizzes more than anyone to patch the holes in your knowledge and clear your doubts."

Although the disciples are often left with spinning heads and sweaty palms, it truly feels as if they have been steeped in a scalding hot spring. Once they return to their quarters and let the steam clear, they usually find their minds sharper and their understanding deepened.
Because of this, everyone harbors a love-hate relationship with Elder Stork's quizzes.

So be it. Better to treat it as a cleansing sweat. Even if it leaves you dizzy and your stomach tied in knots at the time, you always walk away having gained something.
Think about it. If the day ever comes when Elder Stork no longer wants to quiz you, that would be a far more terrifying thought!

Fortunately, to this day, there has never been a single soul in Mohist City whom Elder Stork deemed unworthy of a test.

zh:
今日天晴，宜去耸翠楼。
才入座，听得隔壁一桌似是在争论桌上那盘江瑶。一人说着，“正值腊月，这江瑶柱如此新鲜，该清蒸才是，怎么只撒了两把盐便烤了，那股子鲜味都没了！”另一人急得拍案：“你如何懂得？这江瑶最新鲜正宗的吃法就是炭烤！渔民自家都是带壳往炭火里一扔，配点盐巴，才叫美味！”我转头看去，却又见一老者笑说：“清蒸是好，只这姜丝若是放的多些，便分不出这玉桂仙君是否新鲜了。”
我看着桌上那碟冒着热气的江瑶，玉珠整齐，圆润剔透，还冒着袅袅热气。恍惚间，似听着一声脆叩。他们争的是火候做法，仙君刚仙逝半个时辰，蒸的烤的都是自己的命啊！

今日落雨，宜去耸翠楼。
春暮时节，荻芽初生，正是河豚最为肥美之时。为了赶上吃着一口鲜味，我掐着时间，耸翠楼一开，便入了座。刚点上一份河豚、一壶美酒，听着门口热闹起来。又有几位郎君结伴而来，谈笑间，听得他们几人也是来尝这河鲜的。“春末荻芽初生时，这河豚最是鲜美，真当称得上是春荣小供奉！”“哦哟！这河豚毒性大，我实是不敢尝鲜啊……”“阿哥何须忧虑？席上规矩，河豚上桌，须得厨子先尝一口，我们才动筷呢。这耸翠楼的厨子烧河豚手艺一绝，必须得吃上这一顿，才算得品过春鲜！”
我已吃了几杯酒，隐约之间，似听得一声鼓气。只是这圆鼓鼓的肚子，一身毒性原是它设的门槛。左右跨得进来，鲜掉魂；跨不进来，馋掉魂！

今日潮信汹涌，宜去耸翠楼。
来得晚些，有一桌已经争得面红耳赤了。不必想，定是因为那石首鱼。“四月石首，鳞下黄油如金，片成薄纸，那一口鲜！”临窗坐着的那位举着酒杯，已咽了口水。“哎……自家吃鱼脍自是别有风味，但若是宴请，还是红烧更为保险。”我心中附和，却又听一人说“应该在江边等渔民新鲜渔获，一把盐烤了！”这人不是上次说要炭烤之人？还真是口味专一。
争论之间，小二已往那桌呈上汤汁稠亮的红烧石首。恍然间听见钱江潮水雷声滚滚……罢了，我今日自家前来，便吃一份石首鱼脍，也算是敬重新美舍人这千里洄游，一身黄油赴死之义！
en:
Fair weather today, fit for a visit to the Verdant Tavern.
No sooner had I taken my seat than I heard the table beside me arguing over a plate of river scallops set before them. One man was saying, "It's the twelfth month, and these scallop meats are so fresh—they ought to be steamed! Why grill them with just two pinches of salt? All that freshness is lost!" Another slapped the table in urgency: "What do you know? The truest, freshest way to eat river scallops is grilled over charcoal! The fishermen themselves just toss them shell and all into the coals, add a bit of salt, and that's the finest flavor there is!" I turned to look, and saw an elder smiling as he said, "Steaming is fine, but if you add too much shredded ginger, you can no longer tell whether this Jade Cinnamon Immortal Lord is truly fresh."
I looked at the plate on their table, still steaming—the pearl-like flesh arranged neatly, round and translucent, wisps of heat still rising from it. In that hazy moment, I thought I heard a crisp little knock. They argued over the method of cooking, yet the Immortal Lord had only just ascended half an hour before—steamed or grilled, either way, it was giving its life all the same!

Rain falls today, fit for a visit to the Verdant Tavern.
In the last days of spring, when the reed shoots first sprout, is exactly when the pufferfish grows fattest and most delicious. To catch that first bite of freshness, I timed my arrival carefully, taking my seat the moment the Verdant Tavern opened its doors. I had just ordered a pufferfish dish and a pot of fine wine when the entrance grew lively. A few more young gentlemen arrived together, and from their laughing chatter, I gathered they too had come to taste this river delicacy. "When the reed shoots first sprout at spring's end, the pufferfish is at its most delicious—truly worthy of being called spring's little offering!" "Oh my! This pufferfish carries such strong poison, I dare not risk a taste..." "Brother, why fret so? By the custom of the table, before the pufferfish is served, the cook must taste it first—only then do we lift our chopsticks. The cook here at Verdant Tavern has a legendary hand with pufferfish; you simply must have this meal, or you cannot say you've truly tasted spring's freshness!"
I had already had a few cups of wine, and in that haze, I thought I heard a low, drumming sound. But that plump, round belly, and the poison within it, were precisely the threshold it had set for itself. Cross it, and lose your soul to the freshness; fail to cross it, and lose your soul to the craving instead!

The tide surges fiercely today, fit for a visit to the Verdant Tavern.
I arrived somewhat late, and already one table had argued themselves red in the face. No need to guess—it must be over the yellow croaker. "In the fourth month, the yellow croaker's flesh beneath the scales runs golden with oil—sliced thin as paper, oh, what a taste!" The man seated by the window, wine cup raised, had already swallowed hard in anticipation. "Ah... eating it raw as sashimi has its own particular flavor, but if you're hosting guests, braising it in soy sauce is still the safer choice." I found myself agreeing in my heart, but then heard another say, "Best to wait by the river's edge for the fishermen's fresh catch, then grill it with a bit of salt!" Wasn't this the very same man who'd argued for charcoal-grilling before? Truly devoted to his one preference.
Amid their debate, the waiter had already brought the braised yellow croaker to their table, its sauce thick and glistening. In that instant, I seemed to hear the Qianjiang tide rolling like distant thunder... Ah, well—since I came alone today, I shall simply order a plate of yellow croaker sashimi myself, as a mark of respect for this noble creature's thousand-mile migration home, and its golden-oiled sacrifice unto death.

【礼运第九】

昔者仲尼与于蜡宾，事毕，出游于观之上，喟然而叹。仲尼之叹，盖叹鲁也。
言偃在侧，曰：“君子何叹？”
孔子曰：“大道之行也，与三代之英，丘未之逮也，而有志焉。大道之行也，天下为公，选贤与能，讲信修睦。故人不独亲其亲，不独子其子，使老有所终，壮有所用，幼有所长，鳏寡孤独废疾者皆有所养，男有分，女有归。货恶其弃于地也，不必藏于己；力恶其不出于身也，不必为己。是故谋闭而不兴，盗窃乱贼而不作，故外户而不闭。是谓大同。今大道既隐，天下为家，各亲其亲，各子其子，货力为己，大人世及以为礼，城郭沟池以为固，礼义以为纪，以正君臣，以笃父子，以睦兄弟，以和夫妇，以设制度，以立田里，以贤勇知，以功为己。故谋用是作，而兵由此起。禹、汤、文、武、成王、周公由此其选也。此六君子者，未有不谨于礼者也。以着其义，以考其信，着有过，刑仁讲让，示民有常，如有不由此者，在埶者去，众以为殃。是谓小康。”
言偃复问曰：“如此乎礼之急也？”孔子曰：“夫礼，先王以承天之道，以治人之情，故失之者死，得之者生。诗曰：‘相鼠有体，人而无礼。人而无礼，胡不遄死？’是故夫礼，必本于天，肴于地，列于鬼神，达于丧祭射御、冠昏朝聘。故圣人以礼示之，故天下国家可得而正也。”
言偃复问曰：“夫子之极言礼也，可得而闻与？”孔子曰：“我欲观夏道，是故之杞，而不足征也，吾得夏时焉。我欲观殷道，是故之宋，而不足征也，吾得坤乾焉。坤乾之义，夏时之等，吾以是观之。”
夫礼之初，始诸饮食。其燔黍捭豚，污尊而抔饮，蒉桴而土鼓，犹若可以致其敬于鬼神。及其死也，升屋而号，告曰：“皋某复。”然后饭腥而苴孰，故天望而地藏也。体魄则降，知气在上，故死者北首，生者南乡，皆从其初。
……
en:
【Book of Rites IX: The Conveyance of Rites】

In ancient times, Confucius was once a guest attendant at the year-end sacrifice. After the ceremony, he wandered to the top of the gate tower and sighed deeply. His sigh was for the state of Lu.
Yan Yan, who was at his side, asked, "Why does the Master sigh?"
Confucius replied, "When the Great Way prevailed, and when the eminent men of the Three Dynasties flourished, I was not born in time to witness them, yet I have aspired to them. When the Great Way prevailed, the world was shared by all. The worthy and able were chosen to lead, and trust was fostered and harmony cultivated. Therefore, people did not treat only their own kin as kin, nor only their own children as children. The aged were cared for until their end, the able-bodied found useful employment, and the young were nurtured to maturity. Widowers, widows, orphans, the childless, the disabled, and the sick were all provided for. Men had their proper roles, and women had their proper homes. Goods were not discarded on the ground, yet neither were they hoarded for oneself. Strength was not withheld from exertion, yet it was not spent solely for one's own benefit. Thus, scheming ceased, and theft, rebellion, and disorder did not arise. Outer doors were left open and never shut. This was called the Grand Unity. Now the Great Way has become hidden, and the world is treated as one's own family. Each person cherishes only their own kin and cares only for their own children. Goods and strength are used for oneself. Rulers regard hereditary succession as proper, and walls and moats are built for defense. Rites and righteousness serve as the guiding principles, to order the relationship between ruler and minister, to deepen the bond between father and son, to harmonize brotherhood, to bring concord between husband and wife, to establish institutions, to set up fields and settlements, to honor the brave and wise, and to reward merit for oneself. Thus, scheming arises, and warfare follows. Yu, Tang, Wen, Wu, King Cheng, and the Duke of Zhou were the chosen ones of this age. These six gentlemen were all meticulous in observing rites. Through rites, they made righteousness manifest, tested sincerity, exposed faults, modeled benevolence, and taught deference, showing the people constant standards. If any ruler failed to follow these ways, he was removed from power, and the people regarded him as a calamity. This was called the Lesser Prosperity."
Yan Yan asked again, "Is rites truly so urgent?" Confucius said, "Rites are how the former kings inherited the Way of Heaven and governed human emotions. Therefore, one who loses them perishes, and one who attains them survives. The Book of Songs says: 'Look at the rat—it has a body. If a man has no rites, if a man has no rites, why does he not quickly die?' Thus, rites must be rooted in Heaven, spread upon the Earth, arrayed among ghosts and spirits, and extended to mourning, sacrifice, archery, charioteering, capping ceremonies, weddings, court audiences, and diplomatic missions. Therefore, the sage presents rites to the people, and thus the world, the states, and the families can be set in order."
Yan Yan asked again, "The Master speaks of rites in such extreme terms—may I hear more?" Confucius said, "I wished to observe the ways of the Xia dynasty, so I went to Qi, but its records were insufficient to verify them. Yet I obtained the Xia Calendar there. I wished to observe the ways of the Yin dynasty, so I went to Song, but its records were insufficient to verify them. Yet I obtained the Kun Qian there. From the meaning of the Kun Qian and the gradations of the Xia Calendar, I was able to perceive these ways."
In the beginning, rites arose from food and drink. People roasted millet and tore apart pork, scooped water from hollowed pits and drank from their hands, fashioned drums from clay and beat them with earthen sticks—and even so, they could express reverence to ghosts and spirits. When one died, they climbed to the roof and wailed, calling out: "Oh, so-and-so, return!" Then they placed raw rice in the mouth and wrapped cooked food for burial. Thus, they looked to the heavens above and buried in the earth below. The body and the corporeal soul descend, while the spirit and breath ascend on high. Therefore, the dead are laid with their heads to the north, and the living face south—all following the customs of antiquity.

zh:
少东家大人尊鉴：

此次虽是私人出游，小做做仍时刻记挂工作！

为实现给咱家业降本增效的目标，小做做制定并执行了计划：先以结义为名建立信任，随后借机脱身，成功诱导方旭主动承担了全场酒食开销。

不过，此人看着憨，脾气倒暴得很。小的寻思着帮他 “找个好去处”，把他当二次资源卖掉，顺带还能帮咱家赚得一笔意外之财，就将他哄去了一处快活窝里……结果，我跟牙人对齐信息，商量价格的功夫，这厮提刀就将人家的场子给拆了！连累得小的被那家的护院追了开封城整整三圈，才将将逃出生天！！！

不过这傻大个很好说话，小的不过包装了一番话术，他就相信小的也是被那牙人骗了。临别时，小的又哭诉了句家贫，他竟二话不说，就塞了小的一千通宝！

这钱如今已被小的我附在信笺里，想必少东家大人您收信之时，也定然已收到了钱。

这俗话说得好啊，白掉的馅饼，不捡白不捡。

这钱您收着，就权当小做做给您寻的孝敬了！相关行动细节及目标人物观察报告，待小做做归府后将当面给您沉浸式汇报。

您最衷心的李来做敬上
en:
To the Young Master:
Though this was a private trip, your humble Laizuo is still constantly thinking of work!
I must share an unexpected gain with you: Have you ever heard of a wanderer in Qinghe named $C$L#Y$PN#E$C? This fellow actually has a simple-minded wealthy fool named Fang Xu working under him, who is incredibly generous with his money.
To achieve our family goal of cost-cutting and efficiency optimization, I formulated and executed a plan: first, build trust under the guise of sworn brotherhood, then take the opportunity to slip away, successfully inducing Fang Xu to voluntarily cover all the food and drink expenses.
However, although he looks dim-witted, his temper is quite explosive. I thought about "finding him a good place" to sell him off as a secondary resource, which would have earned our family some extra coins. So, I lured him into a den of pleasure... but while I was aligning info with the broker to negotiate a price, this guy drew his blade and tore the place apart! I was chased through Kaifeng by their guards for three whole laps in Kaifeng City before I barely managed to escape with my life!!!
But this big lug is very easy to talk to. I just packaged my words a bit, and he believed that I was also tricked by that broker. Upon parting, I lamented my family's poverty, and without a word, he stuffed 1,000 coins into my hand!
I've attached this money to the letter. By the time you receive this, Young Master, you must have already received the coins.
As the saying goes, a free meal is a meal you shouldn't miss.
Take these coins as a token of my respect! I will give you a thorough report on the action details and the target character observation when I return.
Your most loyal Li Laizuo

zh: 指射工之毒侵袭人体而致的病证。射工又名蜮、短狐、水狐、水弩等，古籍记载不一，有说是狐狸，有说是三足鳖，有说是一种长翅膀的甲虫，能含沙射影致人生病，似为某种水中寄生虫。起病初期，症状或像伤寒，或像中恶，或口不能语，或身体苦强，或厌恶寒热、四肢拘急、头痛、骨悁久伸、张口欠呿，或早晨稍微缓解，傍晚则开始病情加剧。加剧不出三日，则齿间出血，不立即治疗则会病卒。
en: Refers to an illness caused by exposure to the poison of the Shegong, a term also known in ancient texts as Yu, Short Fox, Water Fox, or Water Crossbow. Accounts vary: some describe it as a kind of fox, others as a three-legged soft-shelled turtle, and still others as a winged beetle-like creature that "spits sand at one's shadow," causing mysterious sickness. It is speculated to be a type of waterborne parasite. In the early stages, symptoms may resemble typhoid or sudden evil affliction. Patients may lose the ability to speak, suffer rigidity of the body, chills, alternating cold and heat, stiffness in limbs, headache, prolonged muscle tension, involuntary yawning or jaw opening. Symptoms may ease in the morning but worsen by dusk. Within three days of intensifying, bleeding between the teeth may occur. If untreated, the illness can prove fatal.

谁也不知道这只白毛狗今年到底多大。
它自己也说不清楚。
它的毛，是天生就这样一片雪白，还是从黑到灰、又从灰到白、被岁月一寸寸磨成了现在的颜色？
它自己也不记得了。

所以有时候，白毛狗自己也觉得，它活得太久太久了。
久到，它忘了很多事。
久到，它快忘了，自己不叫“白毛狗”，它是有名字的。

那名字……都被谁叫过呢？
是笑语盈盈的女子，摸着它的头，叫的吗？
是奶声奶气的小孩，扑在它身上，喊的吗？
是意气风发的少年，站在它面前，问的吗？

它似乎忘了，又似乎没有。
时间不停，人群向前，它独自向后。
en:
No one knows exactly how old this white dog is.
He can't say for sure himself.
Was his fur always this snowy white, or did it turn from black to grey, and from grey to white, worn down to this color by time, inch by inch?
He doesn't remember either.

So sometimes, Old Snow feels like he's lived for far too long.
Long enough to forget many things.
Long enough to almost forget that he isn't just called "White-Haired Dog," but that he has a name.

Who... who used to call him by that name?
Was it a smiling woman, stroking his head while she said it?
Was it a child with a tiny voice, pouncing on him and shouting it?
Was it a spirited youth, standing before him and asking it?

He seems to have forgotten, yet seems not to.
Time never stops, and the crowds move forward, while he alone moves backward.

zh:
阿舍是一只跑得很快的小猫。可是，一只猫跑得快，又有什么用呢？
它能从山底跑上山顶，从长安跑到凉州，可是那个胡子拉碴的男人摸摸它的头把它送走之后，它再也跑不回他身边了。
它不再做一只跑得快的小猫，它成为一只整天一动不动的小猫。
安一飞把它抱在怀里翻书，翻了一本又一本。正当安一飞打算给它取名“不动”时，它的爪子轻轻在“丙舍旁启”中按下一朵梅花。
“舍旁？小旁？”
安一飞观察着它的反应，试探着唤它，
“阿舍？”
一动不动的小猫轻轻喵了一声，安一飞猛猛把脸埋进阿舍的肚子狂吸，
“阿舍很好呀！阿舍，阿舍，有舍就会有得。”
en:
A'she was a swift little cat, fleet-footed and full of life. But what good is speed when it no longer matters? 
It once ran from the base to the summit of mountains, from Chang'an to Liangzhou. Yet, after the scruffy man who once stroked its head sent it away, it never raced back to him again. 
No longer the swift kitten it used to be, it became still—quiet and motionless for days on end. 
An Yifei held it close, flipping through book after book. The cat gently pressed its paw on characters "Bing, She, Pang, Qi"—referred to opening the side gate of a pavilion nearby, a subtle welcome. 
"She Pang? Little She?" 
Watching carefully, An Yifei softly called out, 
"A'she?" 
The once-motionless cat let out a tender meow, responding to the name. Overcome with affection, An buried her face into A'she's soft belly and breathed deeply. 
"A'she is perfect. A'she—for every shelter there is a blessing."

西汉武帝年间，西域有古国乌孙，不务农耕，以游牧为生，地产良马。《汉书·张骞传》记载：“骞既至乌孙，致赐谕指……乌孙发译道送骞，与乌孙使数十人，马数十匹，报谢，因令窥汉，知其广大。”张骞出使西域，将乌孙骏马带回中原，汉武帝见乌孙马神骏非凡，欣喜万分，名曰“西极”。
乌孙西极体格魁伟，四肢强健，头颅小巧，耳短眸清，外形俊秀。性温顺，耐粗放，春夏时节食草增膘，秋冬时节亦能刨雪觅食，力速兼备，挽乘皆宜，为西域特有的良马马种。
en:
In the Book of Songs, the Prase-odes of Loo-Keung states, "Some, yellowish red; some, dapple grey; all, strong carriage horses." The Jade Book explains, "A horse is yellowish red." The color defines a Xing. Because of its rare luster that gleams brilliantly in sunlight, pure gold-colored horses are most prized among Wusun Western Rarities.
During Emperor Wu of the Western Han, the nomadic state of Wusun in the Western Regions was famed for its fine horses.
As recorded in the Book of Han, Biography of Zhang Qian, "Upon arrival in Wusun Kingdom, Zhang Qian delivered imperial gifts... the state dispatched envoys and gifted dozens of horses in return to detect the vastness of Western Han." Zhang Qian brought Wusun steeds back to the Central Plains. Emperor Wu, impressed by their spirit and beauty, named them "Western Rarity."
Wusun Western Rarities are large and powerful, with well-shaped limbs, small heads, short ears, and bright eyes. Gentle in nature and hardy by breed, they fattened easily in summer pastures and foraged even through winter snow. Strong and swift, they served equally well for riding or dragging, an exceptional breed unique to the Western Regions.

「风雷赛」采用调平模式，游侠与首领的属性（首领气血除外）与「试炼」鬼神愁难度一致，武学、心法、奇术可在挑战前自由搭配，挑战开始后可在准备阶段切换武学搭配和天工开物。

海选赛中选手需依次挑战3名指定首领（「皮影·幕起」「无名将军」「伊刀」），每名首领拥有3次挑战机会，完成当前首领全部挑战后，方可解锁下一名首领，并以3次挑战中的最短用时作为其最优成绩；该最优成绩所使用的武学组合将被锁定，禁止在后续首领挑战中重复使用。总成绩为三名首领最优成绩的用时之和，选手可通过「试炼」玩法进行训练。

淘汰赛中选手需连续挑战三名固定首领（淘汰赛为「皮影·幕起」「无名将军」「伊刀」），单次挑战内血量与药品数量全程继承不重置，且不同首领需使用完全不同的武学（仅单次挑战内限制），每个首领准备阶段可通过培养和背包切换武学及天工开物，完成准备后会直接传送进入战斗，共3次挑战机会，最终取最短用时作为成绩。奖励在审核期结束后领取。若失败情况下则依次按选手最佳成绩的通关首领数量和通关时间进行排序。

决赛的挑战规则同淘汰赛，最后一名首领决赛当日公布。
en:
Players must abide by the Where Winds Meet General Tournament Rules. See the "General Tournament Rules" section on the official Where Winds Meet Tournament Center website. 

The "Tempest" uses a balanced mode. Attributes for Wanderers and Bosses (excluding Boss HP) match the "Trial" Abyss difficulty. Martial Arts, Inner Ways, and Mystic Skills can be freely configured before the challenge. After the challenge starts, you can switch Martial Arts and Divinecraft during the preparation phase. 

In the Qualifiers, players must challenge 3 designated Bosses in order ("Puppeteer - Overture", "General Nameless", "Yi Dao"). Each Boss has 3 challenge attempts. You can only unlock the next Boss after completing the challenge for the current one. The shortest time among the 3 attempts is recorded as the best result; the Martial Arts combination used for this best result will be locked and cannot be reused in subsequent Boss challenges. The total score is the sum of the best times for all three Bosses. Players can train via the "Trial" mode. 

In the Elimination Stage, players must consecutively challenge three fixed Bosses (Elimination Bosses: "Puppeteer - Overture", "General Nameless", "Yi Dao"). HP and medicine counts are inherited throughout the single run and do not reset. Completely different Martial Arts must be used for different Bosses (restriction applies only within a single run). Martial Arts and Divinecraft can be switched via Training and Bag during each Boss's preparation phase. Combat starts automatically after preparation. There are 3 challenge attempts, with the shortest total time taken as the final score. Rewards are claimed after the review period. In case of failure, ranking is based on number of Bosses defeated and clear time of the best attempt. 

The Finals follow the same rules as the Elimination Stage. The final Boss will be announced on the day of the Finals.

那鬼街上，有好些外头难见的宝物；而行走于其间的人，皆覆鬼面，不知身份，甚是神秘！
还有那鬼街店铺的掌柜们，听说各个都身手不凡，有几位还是江湖上响当当的大人物。
好想一睹他们的真面目啊！但那遛鸟的老先生说，要想活着离开，最好别动歪脑筋……好吧，天地之大，尚有诸多有趣之事未能体验，我可得保护好我的小命！

en:
I'd long heard of the Ghostlight Market beneath Kaifeng—a mysterious realm beyond the mortal world, where countless treasures are sold and all manner of wanderers and oddities gather. Seeing it today, it lives up to every rumor. 
On the Ghost Street, rare treasures abound—ones never seen aboveground. And everyone here wears a ghost mask, their identities hidden in mystery. 
Rumor has it that even the Ghost Street shopkeepers are masters of martial arts—some even legendary figures in the jianghu. 
How I wish to see their true faces! But the elder with a birdcage warned: "To leave alive, don't get any bright ideas." Fair enough—the world is vast, and I've too many adventures left to risk my life here. 
As for the Ghostlight Market's other secrets... I'll uncover them on my next visit.
Wen Manyan Yuan

zh:
年轻人：
       好久不见，最近过得还好吗？
       托你的福，摊子的生意很好。你阿婶她很久没有这么高兴了，每天笑盈盈地和来往客人唠家常，开心的时候还会借着琵琶摊小娘子的曲子跳上几步！不忙的时候，老张和老幺还张罗着去和赛神队的几个小伙子比赛，哈哈。
      天水集的大伙儿都会提起你，说你行侠仗义，我们听着都很开心，也惦记着你。你阿婶怕你在外面吃不饱穿不暖，时常念叨你呢。有时间就来摊子坐坐啊。
      对了，开烫菜摊子赚了些钱，我们想着也帮衬帮衬别人，就做了些饭菜送给了几个老伙计。怕他们觉得不好意思，我们几个就说，是你要给他们送的。他们还奇怪，说怎么会有没见过的好心人惦记他们呢。老张说这孩子就是这样的，是个热心肠的大侠！他们不太好意思，就给你写了字条，你一起看看吧。
      好了，不说了，待会要来客人了，就到这儿吧。
      希望你一个人在外吃饱穿暖，平平安安。
<IMAGE id='im1' image_url='https://h72.fp.ps.netease.com/file/6891d8a2b9c8a8db0a93ffbegcJsG6iU06' size='2290*1296' color='255;255;255')'></IMAGE>
en:
Young Hero: 
Long time no see. How have you been? 
Thanks to you, the stall is doing great. Your Auntie hasn't been this happy in ages—she smiles, chatting with customers all day, and even dances a few steps when the Pipa lady plays! When it's slow, Old Zhang and Old Yao even try to race the lads from the deity competition team, haha. 
Everyone at Skybrim Market speaks of your chivalry. We are happy to hear it and miss you often. Your Auntie worries you aren't eating well or staying warm. She talks about you all the time. Come visit the stall when you can. 
Oh, we made some money from the scalding vegetable stall, so we thought we'd help others out. We sent some food to a few old partners. We were afraid they'd feel embarrassed, so we said it was from you. They were surprised a kind hero remembered them! Old Zhang said, "That child is just warm-hearted like that!" They were shy, so they wrote you notes. Take a look. 
Okay, customers are coming. I'll stop here. 
Stay warm, fed, and safe out there.

世人常言窈窕淑女，君子好逑。然缘非天成，求之不得，徒呼奈何。余怜天下孤苦，著《调光经》一部，奇计三十有六以助君子。
《调光经》于中蕴奥；爱女论就里玄微。决烈妇闻乎即肯；相思病随手能医。
<羞羞羞，居然是教这个的。听说这本书是醉花阴一个高手写的。爹爹当年就是凭借这本书追上阿娘，后来更是狂澜上下人手一本，可就是不让我看。哼，我倒要看看有什么猫腻。>
计一：冷笑徉言，装痴倚醉。
<哦？原来是这样，我说为什么自从我和李安哥哥说想要娶他，他就开始不理我了。我到处找他，他还当看不见我。嘻嘻，原来都是装的呀。我也要试试。>
计二：屈身下气，俯就承迎。
<每次李安哥哥和我说话都会蹲下来，他说的话又温柔又好听，这就是喜欢么？>
计三：陪一面之虚情，做许多之假意。先称他容貌无只，次答应殷勤第一。
<嘿嘿，李安哥哥第一次见面的时候就夸我。当时我偷溜到中原遇到几个锈金楼的坏人，就在我要把他们打死的时候，李安哥哥出现了，他说这么可爱的小姑娘，打打杀杀的不好。没错，他夸我可爱。哎呀，我都不好意思了。可惜后来我要把他抓回去的时候，他拒绝了。>
计四：常时节将无做有，几回价送暖偷寒。
<阿娘生我时难产，爹爹寻遍名医，是李安哥哥救了我和阿娘。后来还寄来好多好多的药材，经常嘱咐我要注意保暖不能着凉。>
计五：施恩于未会之前，设计在交关之际。
<以前我还不认识李安哥哥的时候，每次过生日李安哥哥像很多人一样都会给我送来一份大礼，说是为了感谢爹爹当年的一枪之恩。可是我问过爹爹，他以前根本不认识李安哥哥。>
计六：意密致令相见少，情深番使寄书难。
<后来我病好了后李安哥哥就再也不给我写信了。难道是这样？>
en:
"Fair maidens are sought by noble men," they say. But love isn't fated. It must be won. Thus, I present The Art of Light and Shadow, thirty-six tactics for the lovelorn. 
The Art of Light and Shadow holds profound mysteries; Discourse on Wooing Maidens delves into subtle arts. Even the most stubborn woman will yield upon hearing its words; lovesickness can be cured in an instant. 
<Tsk tsk tsk… So this is what it teaches? I heard this book was written by an expert from the Velvet Shade. Father used it to win over Mother back then, and later, everyone in Raging Tides got their hands on a copy, except me. Humph, let's see what secrets it hides.> 
Tactic One: Feign indifference, play the fool, pretend drunkenness 
<Oh? So that's how it is. No wonder ever since I told Li An I wanted to marry him, he's been avoiding me. I'd chase after him, and he'd act like he didn't see me. Heehee, so it was all an act? Well then, I'll try it too.> 
Tactic Two: Lower your pride, humble yourself, and cater to their whims. 
<Every time Li An speaks to me, he crouches down to my level. His words are so gentle and sweet. Is this what liking someone feels like?> 
Tactic Three: Offer empty flattery, lay on the charm. First, praise their unmatched beauty; then, pledge your utmost devotion. 
<Hehe, Li An complimented me the first time we met. I had snuck into the Central Plain and run into some scoundrels from the Aureate Pavilion. Just as I was about to beat them to a pulp, Li An showed up and said, "Such a cute little girl shouldn't be fighting." That's right. He called me cute! Ahh, it's embarrassing just remembering it. Too bad he refused when I tried to drag him back home with me later.> 
Tactic Four: Turn nothing into something, repeatedly show warmth in secret. 
<Mother had a difficult labor when I was born. Father searched everywhere for a miracle doctor, but it was Li An who saved both of us. Afterward, he sent mountains of medicinal herbs and constantly reminded me to stay warm and avoid catching a cold.> 
Tactic Five: Bestow kindness before acquaintance; plan actions at the critical moment. 
<Before I even knew Li An, he sent extravagant birthday gifts every year, just like many others. He said it was to repay Father for a life-saving spear strike from years ago. But when I asked Father, he swore he'd never met Li An before.> 
Tactic Six: Keep meetings scarce to deepen longing; let love flourish through the agony of unanswered letters. 
<After I recovered from my illness, Li An stopped writing to me altogether. Could this be why?>
Insufficient Duanbai Coins
Where the Bones Lie

zh: 又名丹熛、天火、火丹、流火，是一种急性感染性皮肤炎症。多因血分有热，火毒侵袭，或皮肤黏膜破损，邪毒乘隙而入，火热邪毒郁于肌肤，经络阻塞，气血壅遏而成。发病急骤，初起往往先有恶寒发热、头痛骨楚、胃纳不香、便秘溲赤等全身症状。继则局部见小片红斑，迅速蔓延成大片鲜红斑，摸之灼手，肿胀、触痛明显。
en: Also known as Danbiao, Heavenly Fire, Fire Mark, or Flowing Flame, this condition is a form of acute infectious dermatitis. Often caused by heat in the blood and the invasion of fire toxins, or by damage to the skin and mucous membranes allowing foul Qi to enter the body, the affliction manifests when these toxic forces stagnate in the skin, block meridians, and impede the flow of Qi and blood. Onset is sudden, typically beginning with chills, fever, headache, body aches, poor appetite, constipation, and dark urine. Soon after, small red patches appear and rapidly spread into large, fiery-red areas—hot to the touch, swollen, and acutely painful.

zh:
它平日都在晒书广场上翻滚，晒太阳。
从天一楼望下去，就像一滴墨落在熟宣上，边缘毛绒绒的。
看书倦了，摸摸墨点；干活乏了，摸摸墨点；求个好运，更要摸摸墨点。大家都说墨点是只好运的猫，因为它大难不死。
大家一边摸，一边絮絮叨叨地念：墨点啊我想一目十行，墨点啊我想过目不忘，墨点啊我想那人多看我一眼……它听了，只是翻个身，甩甩尾巴尖儿的墨绒。好好好，墨点都知道了。
墨点觉得自己大概是古籍，或者说古籍大概是猫。反正是一类东西——都是被人喜欢的，都是贪恋阳光的。它喜欢躺在古籍旁边，一起晒着。晒舒服了，就会有人来，像翻书一样翻翻它下巴的毛，下巴的毛它自己舔不着。那些手都很暖，像在古籍上流连的阳光。
它本是东岳的野猫，失足跌落山崖，动弹不得。那天眼睛看不太清，只记得遇着一团白白黑黑的影子，惊叫着飞奔过来，把它抱回了蓬山。
后来它慢慢好了，眼睛却回不到从前了。它认识了更多白白黑黑的影子，声音各不相同，都是好影子。
但它永远记得第一个影子的声音。
刚被抱回蓬山那阵子，她天天把它和书一块儿晒：“墨点，到点晒太阳了。你看隔壁那些书，几十上百年了，不管带回来时有多碎，我们都能修补好……你也一样。”它那时还翻不了身，她过一会儿就翻翻它，手法娴熟，给它晒得面面俱到。
原来晒晒太阳，就能活上百年啊。墨点学到了。
那要多晒晒。墨点想着，便把身子摊平，翻出肚皮，向着满天满地的光。
en:
On ordinary days, it rolled about in the book-airing square, soaking up the sun. Viewed from Tianyi Tower above, it looked just like a drop of ink fallen upon sized Xuan paper, with edges soft and fluffy.
Weary of reading, one would pet Ink Dot; tired from chores, one would pet Ink Dot; seeking a little good fortune, one would certainly pet Ink Dot. Everyone said Ink Dot was a cat of good fortune, for it had survived a great fall. As they stroked its fur, they would murmur their wishes: "Ink Dot, let me read ten lines at a glance; Ink Dot, let me never forget what I read; Ink Dot, let that person look my way just once more..." The cat would hear them out, then simply roll over and flick the inky tuft at the tip of its tail. Yes, yes, yes, Ink Dot had heard it all.
Ink Dot had come to feel that it was, in some sense, an ancient text, or perhaps ancient texts were simply cats. They were fundamentally of the same kind: both deeply cherished, and both greedy for the sun's warmth. It loved to lie beside the old scrolls and bask together. When the warmth grew just right, someone would come along and gently ruffle the fur beneath its chin the way one turns the delicate pages of a book, tending to the one spot it could never reach with its own tongue. Those hands were always warm, like sunlight lingering across ancient pages.
It had once been a wild cat from the Eastern Peak until it lost its footing, tumbled down the cliff, and lay helpless. Its vision had been blurred that day; it remembered only encountering a flurry of black and white that cried out in alarm, rushed over, and carried it back to Mount Penglai.
In time it recovered, though its eyes never quite regained their sharpness. It came to know more blurs of black and white, each with a different voice, and all of them kind souls. Yet it never forgot the voice of that very first figure.
In the days just after it was brought to Penglai, she would set it out in the sun alongside the books each day: "Ink Dot, it is time to bask. Look at these books beside you. Some are decades old, some a century and more. No matter how tattered they were when we found them, we have always mended them whole, and you are no different." It could not yet roll over on its own back then, so she would turn it gently with practiced hands, ensuring the sunlight bathed every side.
So that is how one lives for a hundred years, simply by soaking up the sun. Ink Dot had learned its lesson well.
Best to bask as much as possible, then. With that thought, it stretched itself flat, turned its belly to the sky, and opened itself completely to the boundless light filling heaven and earth.

zh:
参与天下争鸣，可以以武会友。在天下争鸣玩法中，各位侠士可以组成5人队，进行5v5比赛竞技。天下争鸣平日19:45开始入场，20:00停止入场；周六、周日19:15开始入场，19:30停止入场。各位侠士请及时参与。比赛开始以后，会将积分相近的至多4个队伍匹配在一起，进行小组循环赛，共计三场，每一场为三局两胜制。获得单场比赛胜利的队伍成员可以获得赛季积分和不肝代币奖励。

天下争鸣玩法中，箭矢使用上限为20支，治疗效果将降低70%。进入战斗一段时间后，玩家伤害将获得提升且治疗效果将进一步下降。

玩家的技能大多都可以以卸势应对，破防奇术不仅不会被卸势，在命中处于防御或在释放卸势技能的目标时，反而有更好的效果，但其可以被任意技能打断。

玩家的各类技能（包括奇术和蓄力技）能够打断轻重击，而反过来则不行。解控技能清风霁月可在受击或控制状态下使用，活用可以有效扭转劣势。

在限定时间内，率先击败对方全部玩家的一方获胜，若倒计时结束未分胜负，按以下优先级依次判定：
1.存活玩家数量更多的一方获胜；
2.若存活玩家数量相同，则总伤害量更高一方获胜；
3.若总伤害量相同，则总治疗量更高一方获胜。
en:
Participate in 5v5 Arena to gain Martial Fellowship. In 5v5 Arena, wanderers can form 5-person teams for 5v5 competitive matches. 5v5 Arena entry opens at 19:45 on weekdays and stops at 20:00. On Saturdays and Sundays, entry starts at 19:15 and stops at 19:30. Please join in time. After the competition starts, up to 4 teams with similar scores will be matched together for a group round-robin tournament, totaling three matches. Each match is best-of-three. Team members who win a single match can earn season points and Engagement Tokens.

In 5v5 Arena, the arrow usage limit is 20, and healing effects are reduced by 70%. After a period of combat, player damage will increase, and healing effects will further decrease.
Most player skills can be countered with Deflect. Break-Defense Mystic Skills are not only immune to Deflect but also have better effects when hitting targets that are defending or using Deflect skills. However, they can be interrupted by any skill.

Various player skills (including Mystic Skills and Charged Skills) can interrupt Light/Heavy Attacks, but not vice versa. The control-breaking skill, Serene Breeze, can be used while being hit or under control. Using it wisely can effectively turn the tide.

Within the time limit, the team that defeats all opposing players first wins. If no winner is decided when time runs out, the following priorities apply in order:
1. The team with more surviving players wins.
2. If the number of surviving players is the same, the team with higher total damage wins.
3. If total damage is the same, the team with higher total healing wins.

The sword's wind howled, kicking up dust and sand, blowing away his sweat and dispersing the summer heat from the entire pool! Bottoms Up Winner—

zh:
每年九月初九，青溪都会忙上一阵。重阳之日，是为耆老致孝之时，泡菊花酒、缝茱萸囊、去村舍义诊看病……要诊的病人多，要忙的事更多，每当如山般的琐事压下时，青溪的师弟妹们，总会将目光投向那个纤瘦的身影。唤一句“师姐”，一切烦杂便总能迎刃而解，村舍里便总响起叫不迭的“师姐”。

听着此起彼伏的呼喊，朱鱼从来不恼，反有些怀念，怀念阿弟阿妹还在时，似曾相识的呼唤。记忆里的村子似乎永远是重阳，婆婆密密缝着茱萸囊，爷爷靠着菊花丛边的篱笆吃酒，太阳要落山了，阿弟阿妹还叫嚷着要登高，往村外的土丘疯跑，攥着转个不停的风车：“阿姊！登高高！”远山的夕阳衬得小孩儿的脸红扑扑，像曛黄光里两颗红通通的朱萸果。夕阳的光很暖和，光里还有弟妹招迎的小手，朱鱼忍不住伸手，脚便往前跨了一步。可这一步，眼前的日光一瞬收没，方才还招摇的两双小手，早已垂落多时，浸在冷雨中，朱鱼手中的金针也落在了地上——最想救的人，还是没能救成。九月九日，重阳，朱鱼生辰，此日后，再没有人唤朱鱼“阿姊”。

“师姐！”揉揉惺忪的眼，朱鱼才发现，累了一天的自己，竟在篱笆边的黄花丛中打了个瞌睡，瞧见师姐窘态的小师妹眨了眨眼，笑道：“师姐，生辰快乐！“岁往月来，忽复九月九。

“师姐，你那么好，就和我的亲阿姊一样，以后我叫你阿姊好不好？”
“连翘赖皮，我也要！”
“我我我，还有我！”
朱鱼看着挤成一团的小豆丁们，笑了笑。
“……好。”
en:
Every year on the ninth day of September, Silver Needle would be busier than ever. Double Ninth Festival was a day to honor the elders. Brewing chrysanthemum wine, stitching silverberry pouches, offering free medical checkups in the village... So many patients to see, even more chores to do. Whenever the burden of it all seemed too heavy, the younger disciples would turn to a slender figure amidst the flurry. One call of "Senior Sister!" and somehow, everything would fall into place. Soon, the village would echo with cries of "Senior Sister!" one after another.

Listening to those calls, Zhu Yu never grew annoyed. If anything, she felt nostalgic. Memories arose of when her own younger siblings were still alive, calling for her in just the same way. In her memory, the village was always bathed in the light of the Double Ninth. Grandmother was stitching silverberry pouches with nimble fingers, and Grandfather was sipping wine by the fence draped in chrysanthemums. As the sun went down, her little brother and sister would shout to go climbing, rushing toward the hills beyond the village, clutching their spinning pinwheels:

"Big Sister! Let's go climb!"

The dusk sun painted their cheeks red, like two bright silverberries gleaming in the golden light. Zhu Yu had reached out her hand, smiling, taking a step toward them. But the sunlight vanished. Those small, waving hands had long since fallen still, soaked in the cold rain. The golden needle slipped from her hand. The ones she most wanted to save... she could not save after all. Ninth day of September, Double Ninth, her birthday. After that day, no one ever called her "Big Sister" again.

"Senior Sister!" Rubbing her bleary eyes, Zhu Yu realized she had dozed off in the yellow flowers by the fence. A younger disciple, grinning at the sight of her flustered senior, chirped, "Senior Sister, happy birthday!" Year after year, and again it was the Double Ninth.

"Senior Sister, you're so kind! You're just like the big sister I always wanted. Can I call you big sister from now on?"

"That's cheating, Forsythia. Me too!"

"And me! And me!"

Zhu Yu looked at the tiny, jostling figures crowding around her, and smiled.

"...Alright."

本届「争鸣赛」参赛限制装备最高为86阶，参与比赛的游侠务必保留好86阶【装备】，在比赛中选手的部分战斗属性进行调平（角色和武学等级为90级，心法为6重，奇术为5重9段，装备叠音最高生效四十五重，解锁当前赛季所有通用型止戈天赋），战斗规则沿用天下争鸣玩法规则。

海选赛开放时间内报名参赛的战队需要自行前往争鸣赛海选界面参与匹配，完成10场海选比赛，成绩审核期24h，次日16:30审核结束，排名前32名的战队进入下一阶段比赛。

小组赛比赛开始前15分钟参赛战队可组队并由队长进入准备场景（需确保5人皆为战队成员），海选晋级战队分为4个小组进行单循环积分赛，采用三局两胜制。
【1】匹配机制：系统将于14:00开始自动为各战队匹配未对阵过的对手，奇数战队数量的小组首领会出现轮空寻找对手较长的情况。
【2】匹配流程：每次返回准备场景后，系统会持续进行新一轮匹配，由于仅匹配未交战的对手，可能出现等待时间较长的情况，请耐心等待。
【3】单循环赛制：需与小组内所有战队完成一轮对阵，小组赛将在所有战队完成相互对阵后结束。\审核时间结束后各小组第一名晋级八强胜者组、第二名晋级八强败者组，奖励在审核期结束后领取。

战队排名依据（按优先级）：胜场总数 > 胜场平均存活人数 > 胜场平均用时（计算平均值时，仅计入非轮空的有效胜场数据）。
en:
Players must abide by the Where Winds Meet General Tournament Rules. See the [General Tournament Rules] section on the official Where Winds Meet Tournament Center website. 

The max Gear Tier for this "Contention Tournament" is Tier 86. Wanderers must keep their Tier 86 [Gear]. Combat attributes will be balanced during the match (Character and Martial Arts Level 90, Inner Ways Tier 6, Mystic Skill Tier 5 Rank 9, Gear Enhancement max 45 stacks, all current season general Arena Talents unlocked). Combat rules follow the 5v5 Arena rules. 

Teams registered during the Qualifiers period must proceed to the Contention Tournament Qualifiers interface to match. Complete 10 qualifying matches. Result review period is 24h, ending the next day at 16:30. The top 32 teams advance to the next stage. 

Participating teams can form a team and enter the preparation scene via the leader 15 minutes before the Group Stage match starts (ensure all 5 members are in the team). Qualifying teams are divided into 4 groups for a Single Round Robin tournament, using a Best of 3 format. 
[1] Matchmaking: The system will automatically match teams against opponents they haven't fought yet starting at 14:00. Groups with an odd number of teams may experience longer wait times due to byes. 
[2] Process: After returning to the preparation scene, the system will continue to match for the next round. Wait times may be longer as it only matches opponents not yet fought. Please wait patiently. 
[3] Round Robin: Teams must complete a match against every other team in the group. The Group Stage ends when all teams have fought each other. After the review time ends, the 1st place of each group advances to the Top 8 Winners Bracket, and the 2nd place advances to the Top 8 Losers Bracket. Rewards are claimed after the review period. 

Team Ranking Criteria (Priority): Total Wins > Avg. Survivors in Wins > Avg. Time in Wins (Calculated using only valid winning matches, excluding byes).

墨城粪男骗感情！
细数此人三宗罪！

粪男介绍：
此男为某位长老的首席弟子！永动鸡的发明者之一！
见人就说自己貌比潘安，倒也是身长七尺，才高八斗！
（有弟子在一旁批注：这位姐妹，你的文字还爱他！）
（有弟子在一旁批注：潘安？墨城还有帅哥？谁啊？）

罪一：约会迟到
约好一道去墨城郊野采风，在寒风中等待半日不来。后问其原由，此男称其提前半日起身准备，过于劳累才不慎睡着。

罪二：不解风情
情到浓时，我同他说我的心里已全是他的影子……他却当场出言反驳，说这是不可能的事。
依据是：景，光至，景亡。若在，尽古息。
此男说我的心中若是有影子，必得先有光，可光又怎能照射人体脏器？遂争执不休，不欢而散！
（有弟子在一旁批注：姐妹好浪漫啊，这句我抄了。）
（有弟子在一旁批注：此男虽然古板，但确实言之有理……这条我站潘安！）

罪三：目中无人
墨城郊野踏青终成行，此男掏出小本言称为我画像，等待三时三刻后，却发现其绘制的竟是永动鸡二代草图，完全无我！

本以为与此男交往，多少能获得一些机巧发明的启发，没成想到头来只是到火神庙求雨——找错了门！
特此警示诸位情窦初开的男男女女们，不要像我一样掉进粪男的陷阱呀！
人心善变，唯有学问是真！

另：永动鸡二代即将开启悬空屋测试，在此招募热心弟子前来体验！
（有弟子在一旁批注：还有此等宣传，真是不择手段……）
en:
Beware: The Scumbag of Mohist City is a Heartbreaker!

He is the Senior Disciple of an Elder! And the "genius" co-inventor of the Perpetual Chicken, always boasting about how handsome he is... Well, he does have some charm.
("Looks like someone's smitten!")
("Who's this handsome man?")

Here are his three great sins!

1. Always late
We planned a countryside outing. I waited hours in the cold while he never showed, claiming he woke early but fell asleep from overwork.

2. Clueless in romance
When I confessed my heart was full of him, he had the gall to argue it was physically impossible. His proof? "A shadow exists when there is light and disappears when the light is gone. If the shadow remains, then something must still be present."
("That's such a good line. I'm stealing it!")
("He sounds reasonable, if a little too rigid... I'm on his side for this!")

3. Self-absorbed
On our outing, he spent hours "drawing me" but was actually sketching blueprints for the new Perpetual Chicken. No sign of me at all.

A word to the lovestruck: don't fall for the narcissist's tricks. Hearts change, but knowledge is forever.
The Perpetual Chicken II is soon to be tested at the Aloft Abode. Stay tuned!

zh: 鬼市子有令，凡于鬼市子行商者，皆须于四更散去，万不可留至卯时。然有一鬼街酒商，日日买醉，一日竟于街头醉卧至卯时。那日他将醒未醒之际，忽闻天际锣响，而后漫天雾起，无数幽魂于其间漂泊游荡。那酒商大惊失色，踉跄逃亡，一路竟恍见灿烂前尘，又似见亡人之境。仓皇之际他跌入黄泉水中，不断挣扎，误抓住生于岸边的金灯花的鳞茎。后不过须臾，他竟觉遍体生寒，五感俱归，而眼前幻境也尽数散去。待大雾散去，酒商醒来，发现个中奥妙——以花蕊酿酒，可混淆五感，生出幻觉；而以鳞茎酿酒，可冷人心脾，忘却前尘。是以第二道酒品，忘川渡，成。
en: By decree of the Ghostlight Market, all merchants must leave by the fourth watch. None may linger until dawn. Yet one wine peddler, drunk as usual, passes out in the street and fails to leave in time. As he drifts between sleep and waking, a distant Gong suddenly rings out. Fog sweeps across the sky, and wraiths wander silently through the mist. Terrified, he flees in a daze, glimpsing flashes of past glory and perhaps the land of the dead. In his panic, he stumbles into the waters of Huang Quan. Flailing helplessly, he grasps the bulb of a red spider lily growing by the riverbank. Moments later, an icy chill spreads through his body. His senses return, and the illusions vanish. When the fog clears and he awakes, he understands its mystery: wine brewed from the flower's stamen causes hallucinations; wine brewed from its bulb chills the heart and wipes away memories. Thus, the second drink, Oblivion Crossing, is born.

en:
Wanderer, that blasted monkey is going to be the death of me! It kept begging and wheedling until I agreed to take it out, and I warned it over and over: once we were outside, it was to listen to its master, stay out of trouble, and absolutely not provoke anything dangerous. It blinked and nodded and looked as innocent as could be. But the moment we stepped out the door, it showed its true colors!
The little menace saw a wild sow with her piglets and immediately got excited. Copying those macaques, it jumped onto the sow's back, grabbed one ear with one hand and yanked her tail with the other. Unexpectedly, the sow went berserk and came charging straight at me, eyes red with fury! I fled in a panic and barely escaped. Tell me, wanderer, isn't that monkey plainly trying to get its master killed?
This time I'm locking it up and making sure it learns its lesson. And don't even think about trying to talk me out of it!
...You forgot?

zh:
冰魄魄不知道自己跑了多久，摔了多少次。手上腿上全都是伤口。
可当她推开房间的门，却发现屋里清辉流转——那是客人自己身上的光华。
她温柔地拉过冰魄魄的手，接过来水坛。
“我的身边也有一只兔子。她像你一样可爱。”
“你是……月亮？”冰魄魄艰难地开口。说完她就觉得自己荒唐的很。
但更荒唐的是，来者微笑地点了点头。
月华神女轻轻捧起水坛，浅浅咂了一口，惬意地笑了笑。
“不要和别人说起，这是属于我和你的秘密。”
“对了，这个留给你。”神女仙袂一挥，冰魄魄手里便多了一块雪白松软的馍馍。
“希望你喜欢。我要走了，再会。”神女的身形化在光中，只一瞬，就闪出门去。
窗外，柔和的月光再次爬上窗沿。

冰魄魄揉着眼睛，只见天际霁月清明，若不是自己手中的馍馍还温热，她真的很难相信刚刚所见的一切。
毕竟，她只是只兔子啊。
en:
Ice Soul had no idea how long she had been running, or how many times she had fallen. Her hands and legs were covered in scrapes. 
But when she pushed open the door to her room, she found it filled with a soft, swirling radiance—a light emanating from the visitor herself. 
Gently, the woman took Ice Soul's hand and accepted the water jar. 
"I, too, have a rabbit by my side. She's just as lovely as you." 
"Are you... the moon?" Ice Soul managed to ask, immediately feeling how absurd the question was. 
Even more absurdly, the visitor smiled and nodded. 
The Lunar Goddess lifted the water jar, took a small sip, and smiled contentedly. 
"Don't tell anyone. This is a secret between you and me." 
"Here, this is for you." With a wave of her sleeve, a soft, white bun appeared in Ice Soul's hands. 
"I hope you like it. I must go now. Farewell." The goddess dissolved into the light and was gone in an instant. 
Outside the window, gentle moonlight once again crept onto the windowsill. 

Rubbing her eyes, Ice Soul saw only a clear moon in the sky. If not for the warmth of the bun in her hand, she could hardly believe what had just happened. 
After all, she was just a rabbit.
Combat Drill ended

zh:
【襄公第九】

元年，春，王正月，公即位。
〇仲孙蔑会晋栾黡、宋华元、卫宁殖、曹人、莒人、邾娄人、滕人、薛人，围宋彭城。
宋华元曷为与诸侯围宋彭城？为宋诛也。其为宋诛奈何？鱼石走之楚，楚为之伐宋，取彭城以封鱼石。鱼石之罪奈何？以入是为罪也。楚已取之矣，曷为系之宋？不与诸侯专封也。
〇夏，晋韩屈帅师伐郑。
〇仲孙蔑会齐崔杼、曹人、邾娄人、耜人，次于合。
〇秋，楚公子壬夫帅师侵宋。
〇九月，辛酉，天王崩。
〇邾娄子来朝。
〇冬，卫侯使公孙剽来聘。
〇晋侯使荀䓨来聘。

二年，春，王正月，葬简王。郑师伐宋。
〇夏，五月，庚寅，夫人姜氏薨。
〇六月，庚辰，郑伯𬑆卒。
〇晋师、宋师、卫宁殖侵郑。秋，七月，仲孙蔑会晋荀䓨、宋华元、卫孙林父、曹人、邾娄人于戚。
〇己丑，葬我小君齐姜。
齐姜者何？齐姜与缪姜，则未知其为宣夫人与？成夫人与？
〇叔孙豹如宋。
〇冬，仲孙蔑会晋荀䓨、齐崔杼、宋华元、卫孙林父、曹人、邾娄人、滕人、薛人、小邾娄人于戚，遂城虎牢。
虎牢者何？郑之邑也。其言城之何？取之也。取之则曷为不言取之？为中国讳也。曷为为中国讳？讳伐丧也。曷为不系乎郑？为中国讳也。大夫无遂事，此其言遂何？归恶乎大夫也。
〇楚杀其大夫公子申。

……
en:
【Duke Xiang, Volume Nine】

First Year, Spring, King's First Month, the Duke assumed the throne.
〇Zhongsun Mie met with Jin's Luan Yan, Song's Hua Yuan, Wei's Ning Zhi, the people of Cao, the people of Ju, the people of Zhulou, the people of Teng, and the people of Xue, to besiege Song's Pengcheng.
Why did Song's Hua Yuan join the feudal lords in besieging Song's Pengcheng? It was to execute punishment on behalf of Song. What was the execution on behalf of Song? Fish Stone fled to Chu, and Chu attacked Song on his behalf, taking Pengcheng to enfeoff Fish Stone. What was Fish Stone's crime? Entering this city was his crime. Since Chu had already taken it, why is it still attributed to Song? Because it does not approve of feudal lords enfeoffing territories without authorization.
〇Summer, Jin's Han Qu led troops to attack Zheng.
〇Zhongsun Mie met with Qi's Cui Zhu, the people of Cao, the people of Zhulou, and the people of Si, and stationed at He.
〇Autumn, Chu's Prince Renfu led troops to invade Song.
〇September, Xinyou, the Heavenly King passed away.
〇The Viscount of Zhulou came to pay homage.
〇Winter, the Marquis of Wei sent Gongsun Piao to pay a visit.
〇The Marquis of Jin sent Xun Ying to pay a visit.

Second Year, Spring, King's First Month, buried King Jian. Zheng's troops attacked Song.
〇Summer, May, Gengyin, Lady Jiang passed away.
〇June, Gengchen, Earl of Zheng, Bi, passed away.
〇Jin's troops, Song's troops, and Wei's Ning Zhi invaded Zheng. Autumn, July, Zhongsun Mie met with Jin's Xun Ying, Song's Hua Yuan, Wei's Sun Linfu, the people of Cao, and the people of Zhulou at Qi.
〇Jichou, buried our minor ruler Qi Jiang.
Who was Qi Jiang? As for Qi Jiang and Miao Jiang, it is unknown whether she was the wife of Duke Xuan or the wife of Duke Cheng?
〇Shusun Bao went to Song.
〇Winter, Zhongsun Mie met with Jin's Xun Ying, Qi's Cui Zhu, Song's Hua Yuan, Wei's Sun Linfu, the people of Cao, the people of Zhulou, the people of Teng, the people of Xue, and the people of Lesser Zhulou at Qi, and then fortified Hulao.
What is Hulao? It is a city of Zheng. Why does it say "fortified"? Because they took it. Since they took it, why not say "took it"? To avoid mentioning it for the Central States. Why avoid mentioning it for the Central States? To avoid mentioning the attack on a state in mourning. Why is it not attributed to Zheng? To avoid mentioning it for the Central States. A high official has no authority to act on his own initiative; why does this say "then"? To attribute blame to the high official.
〇Chu killed its high official, Prince Shen.

……

zh:
“以棋拟战”说来轻巧，但要真正悟透并用于实战却并非易事。燕荧也不藏私，谁来请教都乐意一教，如此教学相长，自身棋术亦能精进。这日，又有同袍过来学棋，燕荧一如往常布下战局教学。对方久战不胜，深感疲惫，正欲认输之际，斜刺里突然插入一个娇俏的女声，阻止了棋局的结束。那女子俊眉修眼、顾盼神飞，一身利落的骑马装英姿飒爽——看衣饰明显是为军中提供马匹与草料的祁家人。她应是极爱下棋且有不错的棋术，接替同袍的位置径直下了起来。但燕荧大势已成，岂可阻挡？女子勉力支撑，走了二十多个回合，终是败了。她的面色瞬间垮了下来，燕荧心中不由生起一股欺负了人的歉疚感，正思量该如何安慰，岂知对方竟先开了口——
“你，可有婚配？”他听到女子如是问。
“没有。”他答。
女子忽然笑了，那一刻，他仿佛看见玉树花开，又像饮下数碗蜜酒，只觉有些晕了。
en:
Simulating a battlefield was one thing; mastering it and applying it to real war was another entirely. Yan Ying never kept his knowledge to himself. He taught freely, to anyone who came seeking. And through teaching, his skill sharpened, each lesson honing his mastery a little more.
One day, as usual, a comrade came seeking a lesson. Yan Ying arranged a complex chessboard to demonstrate his strategies. After many rounds, the comrade was on the verge of conceding when a soft yet spirited voice cut in. It belonged to a young woman. Her eyes were clear and resolute, her brows sharply drawn, and her riding attire crisp and commanding. From the ornamentation on her gear, she seemed to be from the Qi family, known for supplying horses and fodder to the army. She appeared deeply fond of chess and had no small skill herself, stepping into her comrade's place without hesitation. Yet with Yan Ying's advantage already firmly established, how could she hope to turn the tide? Though she fought stubbornly, she lasted little more than twenty moves before admitting defeat. At once, her face fell, and a twinge of guilt stirred in Yan Ying's heart. He was just considering how to offer a few words of comfort when, unexpectedly, the young woman spoke first:
"Have you a marriage bond?"
"No," he answered.
The woman suddenly smiled, and in that instant, Yan Ying felt as if a flower had bloomed before his eyes, or as if he had drunk deep of sweet honeyed wine. His head spun lightly.

此前坊间流言，谓山中之变皆封山派冒进之流为尔。更兼蜚语云，前巨子鸦早察其兆，隐而不发，终招致惨祸。雅素知巨子、前巨子，此说实难置信。此阳是阴非，浸润所入，机甚危也。故某潜伏出外，阴查此事，以实其信。未料所得之证，皆指前巨子。况彼前巨子之位，实多艰厄，屡尝危及。山内人或恶大人开山之举，故称者寡，而雠者众。时前巨子鸦疑为封山派所制，兼有穷奇师横生异变。故某妄自揣测，前巨子或以自污，以巨子位传之。
某闻“爱人者恒爱人”，前巨子玉粹而矩正，与大人有青梅之谊。今盛传兰因絮果，或非前巨子心实所愿。
若此书到，尚非迟，愿大人早为决断；其间倘言辞有失，尚祈大人海涵，勿挂于心。
顺颂时祺。
en:
Greetings, Grandmaster Halcyon.

By the lingering blessing of my forebears, I was saved by your hand. In the years since, even the grief of losing my spouse has slowly begun to ease. This kindness is carved into my bones, and I dare not forget it for a moment. Now, Mohist Hill is beset by turmoil on all sides, and since the events at Spiritroost Crag, I have heard that rumor and slander have gathered around you. My heart has been full of worry. For that reason, I set down below all that I have seen and learned.
Of late, people in the streets say that the disorder within the mountain was caused entirely by the rashness of those who sought to seal it. There are also whispers that former Grandmaster Raven foresaw the signs long ago, yet kept silent, and so brought calamity in the end. I have long known both you and the former Grandmaster, and in truth I find such words hard to believe. To speak one way on the surface while meaning another underneath, letting poison seep in little by little, is the most dangerous thing of all. For that reason, I quietly went out among the common folk and looked into the matter in secret, to test whether these rumors were true. Yet to my surprise, all the traces I found seemed to point instead toward the former Grandmaster.
And yet his position was itself fraught with hardship, and time and again put in peril. Many within the mountain resented your wish to open it, so there were few who spoke for him and many who bore him ill will. At the time, he was also suspected of being held in check by the faction that sought to seal the mountain, while Qiongqi Artificers' sudden disturbance only deepened the chaos. So I have rashly ventured this guess: perhaps he chose to stain his own name, so that the place of Grandmaster might pass to you.
I have heard it said that one who loves others is ever loved in return. The former Grandmaster was pure as jade and upright in rule, and he shared with you a bond that went back to childhood. Now there is much talk of a promising beginning ending in ruin, yet perhaps this was never what he truly wished in his heart.
If this letter reaches you, then it is not yet too late. I only hope you will judge the matter soon. And if anything in my words has overstepped, I beg you to forgive it, and not let it weigh upon your heart.
With best wishes for your peace and well-being.

zh:

当年的他就是这样和老霍并肩而立，一下一下抡圆了膀子，铸出一枚又一枚大历通宝。
只可惜，那些钱很快变成了废铜。他们似乎也变成了无用之人。
烽烟再起的时候，李铁山拿起了一杆枪。这一次，他要继续做个兵。
他拾起了一枚大历通宝，挂在胸前。
铜不是废铜，熔炼后可成为锋刃。
人亦非无用。这一次，李铁山要以一位士兵的身份，熔在沙鸣烽最后的猩红里。
en:
When Li Tieshan struck the war drum for the last time, the Dali coin on his chest burned hot against his skin, as if fresh from the forge.
Years ago, he had stood shoulder to shoulder with Old Huo, their arms swinging tirelessly to mint those very coins.
But soon, the money became worthless scrap, and they, too, felt equally discarded.
When the flames of war ignited again, Li took up a spear. This time, he would continue his duty as a soldier.
He wore that old coin as a reminder.
Copper was not merely scrap. It could be melted down and reforged into a blade.
A man was never useless. This time, Li was ready to be reforged in the crimson fires of battle.
